title: Class-Specific Storylines
content: The best-known class storyline is the Death Knight's: starting at level 55 in Acherus, the Ebon Hold, death knights serve the Lich King in the Scarlet Enclave of the Eastern Plaguelands, earn the Acherus Deathcharger, and break free at the Battle for Light's Hope Chapel before being sent to their faction's capital.

title: Escort and Protection Quests
content: In an escort quest the NPC walks a fixed route and fights beside you; if it dies the quest fails, and you abandon it and take it again once the NPC is back. Party members on the same quest who stay nearby all get credit.

title: Group and Raid Quests
content: Quests tagged Group in the log suggest a party size because their targets are elites, which show a gold dragon on their portrait. While you're in a raid group, ordinary quest kills and items don't count, only quests tagged Raid do, so convert back to a party to finish quests.

title: Repeatable and Daily Quests
content: Daily quests can be done once per day and reset at the realm's daily reset; you can finish up to 25 of them a day. Big Northrend daily hubs are the Argent Tournament, the Sons of Hodir and Wyrmrest Temple, plus the Dalaran cooking and fishing dailies. Some quests, like the raid weekly, reset once a week.

title: Paladin Class Mount
content: Paladins earn their mount through class quests. On this realm the Warhorse quest, The Tome of Nobility, needs level 40 and is handed in to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind; blood elf paladins do The Thalassian Warhorse with Knight-Lord Bloodvalor in Silvermoon. The paladin trainer then teaches the Charger at level 40, once you know the Warhorse and have Journeyman Riding.

title: Warlock Demon Summoning Quests
content: A warlock has the imp at level 1. The voidwalker comes from a level 10 quest called The Binding, the succubus from a level 20 one, and the felhunter from a level 30 one. The first two are given by Gakin the Darkbinder in Stormwind, Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar or Carendin Halgar in Undercity; blood elves hand in their voidwalker quest to Talionia in Silvermoon. The felhunter quest is Strahad Farsan's in Ratchet, in the Barrens.

title: Shaman Totem Quests
content: Each shaman totem element has a class quest: Call of Earth at level 4 gives the Stoneskin Totem, Call of Fire at 10 the Searing Totem, Call of Water at 20 the Healing Stream Totem and Call of Air at 30 the air totem. Orcs and trolls start Earth with Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials and tauren with Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache. Fire ends at Kranal Fiss in the Barrens, Water at Islen Waterseer there, and Air with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.

title: Hunter Pet Leveling and Training
content: A hunter's pet quests start at level 10: Taming the Beast has you use a Taming Rod on a beast near your starting zone and report back, then Training the Beast, or Beast Training for blood elves and draenei, sends you to your hunter trainer in the capital to learn Beast Training, which is how a pet is taught abilities. A pet earns experience when you kill things, never goes above your own level, and this realm triples pet experience. You can tame only beasts at or below your level.
